slides.title: Three kinds of relationship
slides.html:
Relationships

Three kinds of relationship

One-to-one

A user has one profile.

user ↔ profile

One-to-many

A user writes many posts.

post.author → user

Many-to-many

Posts have many tags; tags have many posts.

post.tags: [tagId]

slides.title: Embedding vs referencing
slides.html:
Modelling

Embedding vs referencing

Embed

// Embed: stored inside the post
{
  title: "Hello",
  author: { name: "Ada" },
  tags: ["node", "mongo"]
}
// ✅ one read ❌ copies go stale

Reference

// Reference: store the id
{
  title: "Hello",
  author: ObjectId("675..."),
}
// ✅ one source of truth
// ❌ needs populate()

Embed small things that belong to the parent · reference things that grow or are shared

slides.title: Post model with references
slides.html:
Models

Post model with references

  • ref names the model the id points to
  • Index fields you filter or sort by
  • unique slug for clean URLs

models/Post.js

const postSchema = new mongoose.Schema(
  {
    title: { type: String, required: true, trim: true },
    slug: { type: String, required: true, unique: true },
    body: { type: String, required: true },
    author: { type: Schema.Types.ObjectId, ref: "User", required: true },
    tags: [{ type: String, lowercase: true }],
    status: { type: String, enum: ["draft", "published"], default: "draft" },
  },
  { timestamps: true }
);
postSchema.index({ status: 1, createdAt: -1 });

slides.title: populate(): fill in references
slides.html:
Populate

populate(): fill in references

  • Replaces the id with the real document
  • Choose which fields to include
  • Works on arrays and nested paths

controllers/posts.js

const post = await Post.findById(id)
  .populate("author", "name avatar");
 
// before: author: "675a..."
// after: author: { _id: "675a...", name: "Ada", avatar: "..." }
 
const comments = await Comment.find({ post: id })
  .populate("author", "name")
  .sort({ createdAt: 1 });

slides.title: Pagination and sorting
slides.html:
Pages

Pagination and sorting

  • Never return everything
  • skip = (page − 1) × limit
  • Send totals so the frontend can build pages

Paginated list

const page = Math.max(1, Number(req.query.page) || 1);
const limit = Math.min(50, Number(req.query.limit) || 10);
const sort = req.query.sort === "oldest" ? "createdAt" : "-createdAt";
 
const [items, total] = await Promise.all([
  Post.find(filter).sort(sort).skip((page - 1) * limit).limit(limit),
  Post.countDocuments(filter),
]);
 
res.json({ items, page, limit, total, pages: Math.ceil(total / limit) });

slides.title: Indexes make queries fast
slides.html:
Indexes

Indexes make queries fast

  • Without an index, MongoDB reads every document
  • Index what you filter, sort and search
  • Text index for keyword search
  • Too many slow down writes

Indexes

postSchema.index({ author: 1, createdAt: -1 });
postSchema.index({ tags: 1 });
postSchema.index({ title: "text", body: "text" });
 
// text search
Post.find({ $text: { $search: "express mongo" } });
 
// check a query is using an index
await Post.find({ tags: "node" }).explain("executionStats");

slides.title: Aggregation pipelines
slides.html:
Aggregation

Aggregation pipelines

  • Data flows through stages
  • $match filters, $group summarises
  • $lookup joins another collection
  • Great for stats and dashboards

Top tags

// posts per tag, most popular first
await Post.aggregate([
  { $match: { status: "published" } },
  { $unwind: "$tags" },
  { $group: { _id: "$tags", count: { $sum: 1 } } },
  { $sort: { count: -1 } },
  { $limit: 10 },
]);
// [{ _id: "node", count: 12 }, { _id: "mongo", count: 9 }]

slides.title: Virtuals and middleware hooks
slides.html:
Hooks

Virtuals and middleware hooks

  • virtual: a computed field, not stored
  • pre("save") runs before saving
  • Use hooks for slugs, hashing, cleanup

models/Post.js

postSchema.virtual("readingTime").get(function () {
  return Math.ceil(this.body.split(" ").length / 200) + " min";
});
 
postSchema.pre("validate", function () {
  if (this.isModified("title")) {
    this.slug = this.title.toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/(^-|-$)/g, "");
  }
});

slides.title: Listing posts
slides.html:
Build

Listing posts

  • Build the filter from the query
  • paging(): a helper for page, limit, skip
  • Populate the author's name

controllers/posts.js

export const list = async (req, res) => {
  const { tag, author, q } = req.query;
  const filter = { status: "published" };
  if (tag) filter.tags = tag.toLowerCase();
  if (author) filter.author = author;
  if (q) filter.$text = { $search: q };
 
  const { page, limit, skip } = paging(req.query);
  const [items, total] = await Promise.all([
    Post.find(filter).populate("author", "name").sort("-createdAt").skip(skip).limit(limit),
    Post.countDocuments(filter),
  ]);
  res.json({ items, page, total, pages: Math.ceil(total / limit) });
};
